# GetPYQ - BPUT Previous Year Question Papers

> GetPYQ - BPUT Previous Year Question Papers is a free, student-built archive of Biju Patnaik University of Technology (BPUT) previous year question papers (PYQ), regular & back examination papers, and peer solution notes across all B.Tech engineering branches and semesters (1st Sem to 8th Sem).

## Key Facts
- Brand Name: GetPYQ - BPUT Previous Year Question Papers
- University Covered: BPUT (Biju Patnaik University of Technology, Rourkela, Odisha)
- Semesters Covered: 1st Sem, 2nd Sem, 3rd Sem, 4th Sem, 5th Sem, 6th Sem, 7th Sem, 8th Sem
- Exam Types: Regular/Back and Back previous year question papers (PDF)
- Access: 100% free, instant PDF preview and download without login or paywall
- Paper Data Source: Live community-verified archive served dynamically via API

## B.Tech Engineering Branches Covered
- CSE (Computer Science & Engineering, CS, IT): https://getpyq.vercel.app/branch/cse
- CSE (AI & ML) / AIML (Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning): https://getpyq.vercel.app/branch/cse-aiml
- ECE / ETC (Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering, Electronics & Communication): https://getpyq.vercel.app/branch/ece
- EE (Electrical Engineering): https://getpyq.vercel.app/branch/ee
- EEE (Electrical & Electronics Engineering, Electrical and Electronics): https://getpyq.vercel.app/branch/eee
- ME (Mechanical Engineering, Mech): https://getpyq.vercel.app/branch/me
- Civil / CE (Civil Engineering): https://getpyq.vercel.app/branch/civil
- Chemical / CHE (Chemical Engineering): https://getpyq.vercel.app/branch/chemical
- Automobile (Automobile Engineering): https://getpyq.vercel.app/branch/automobile
- Material & Metallurgy / MME (Metallurgy, Material & Metallurgical Engineering): https://getpyq.vercel.app/branch/metallurgy
- Biotech (Biotechnology, Bio-Tech): https://getpyq.vercel.app/branch/biotech

- Home & Search: https://getpyq.vercel.app/
